notes: immersive_locations.zip was converted into settlement modules rather than copied as standalone HTML pages.
No SVG image files from immersive locations were embedded or copied.
Python/PHP/userscript repositories are represented as static planning, manifest, import, or UI modules because GitHub Pages cannot run those runtimes directly.

repositories.adapter: 52 structured settlement modules + index + JSON record set; original page wrappers not used; SVG images excluded
UniversalVTT / DungeonFog to Fantasy Grounds conversion planner module
static login/gate UI module with backend event hook placeholder
SVG/LOS format reference notes module; no SVG images embedded
tile filename manifest planner module for external assembly workflow
